notes.title: Warrior lords is out now!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

[b]Warrior lords is out now and you can get it for 6$ during the launch period![/b]

[previewyoutube=J7Qf4zpZKtk;full][/previewyoutube]

Warrior lords is a game I had a lot of fun making, you can play as different heroes and defeat 5 stages all belonging to the other heroes to win the arcade campaign.

If you have any questions or comments, feel free to let me know!

[previewyoutube=AM742Ev1PQs;full][/previewyoutube]
